package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/contentaccess"
	examplerelationuc "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/examplerelation"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

// ExampleRelationsHandler handles semantic links between lesson examples.
type ExampleRelationsHandler struct {
	Validator *validator.Validate
	ReplaceUC examplerelationuc.ReplaceExampleRelations
	ListUC    examplerelationuc.ListExampleRelations
	DeleteUC  examplerelationuc.DeleteExampleRelation
	Access    contentaccess.Service
}

type exampleRelationRequest struct {
	ID              string   `json:"id" validate:"omitempty,uuid"`
	SourceKey       string   `json:"source_key" validate:"required,max=255"`
	TargetExampleID string   `json:"target_example_id" validate:"required,uuid"`
	Relation        string   `json:"relation" validate:"required,oneof=implementation practice comparison reference prerequisite continuation see_also"`
	PrimaryStack    string   `json:"primary_stack" validate:"required,max=128"`
	Stacks          []string `json:"stacks" validate:"required,min=1,dive,required,max=128"`
	Concepts        []string `json:"concepts" validate:"required,min=1,dive,required,max=128"`
}

type replaceExampleRelationsRequest struct {
	Relations []exampleRelationRequest `json:"relations" validate:"required,dive"`
}

func (h ExampleRelationsHandler) Replace(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req replaceExampleRelationsRequest
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(r.Body)
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	relations := make([]domain.LessonExampleRelation, 0, len(req.Relations))
	for _, item := range req.Relations {
		relations = append(relations, domain.LessonExampleRelation{
			ID:              item.ID,
			SourceKey:       item.SourceKey,
			TargetExampleID: item.TargetExampleID,
			Relation:        item.Relation,
			PrimaryStack:    item.PrimaryStack,
			Stacks:          item.Stacks,
			Concepts:        item.Concepts,
		})
	}
	if err := h.ReplaceUC.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "sourceExampleID"), relations); err != nil {
		writeLessonExampleError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

func (h ExampleRelationsHandler) ListAdmin(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	h.list(w, r, false)
}

func (h ExampleRelationsHandler) ListPublic(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if err := h.Access.RequireExample(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "sourceExampleID"), ""); err != nil {
		writeContentAccessError(w, err)
		return
	}
	h.list(w, r, true)
}

func (h ExampleRelationsHandler) list(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, activeOnly bool) {
	relations, err := h.ListUC.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "sourceExampleID"), activeOnly)
	if err != nil {
		writeLessonExampleError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"example_relations": relations})
}

func (h ExampleRelationsHandler) Delete(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if err := h.DeleteUC.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "relationID")); err != nil {
		writeLessonExampleError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}
